scientific_intent.scientific_task: Typed dense row-major matrix multiplication through cuBLASLt
scientific_intent.description: Source vendor-library benchmark computes C=AB with alpha1/beta0 via row-major-to-column-major layout mapping, managed A/B/C and source heuristic/workspace orchestration. Actual native double operand swap instead computes BA on safe square input. Named conditional study corrects only this duplicate operand swap, retaining source API descriptors/heuristic and FP32 switch fallthrough.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: C[i,j]=sum_q A[i,q]B[q,j]; bounded dyadic real and exact integer matrices.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact all entries on declared bounded quarter-dyadic inputs, whose products/partial sums are representable even in BF16/F16. This controls API/layout/math correctness but does not stress arbitrary low-precision rounding or identify internal vendor accumulation instructions.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Dense linear algebra building block; no specific physical application inferred from benchmark name.
scientific_intent.provenance: Original main.cu/test_gemm/LtSgemmCustomFind source review plus actual safe noncommuting GPU witness and published CUDA API ABI headers.
